_comment: Chosen voice for the workshop receptionist. To swap: change voice_id here, in vapi/assistant.json (voice.voiceId) and keep Config.greeting_name_for_agent consistent with the voice.

chosen.name: Charlie - Deep, Confident, Energetic
chosen.why: The only Australian-accented voice on the account, and the accent callers of a suburban Melbourne workshop expect. Its use-case is conversational rather than narration, so it holds up across interruptions and very short turns. It was also the fastest full render of the shortlist (1.05 s for a 19.5 s script) - Vapi streams the audio, so slow first-audio is heard as dead air.

settings_rationale.stability: 0.45 is just below the 0.5 default: a little more life, still steady over a multi-minute call. Above ~0.6 a repeat-price receptionist sounds robotic; below ~0.3 it drifts on numbers.
settings_rationale.similarity_boost: 0.75 keeps the voice identity intact on telephony-bandwidth audio without cloning artefacts.
settings_rationale.style: 0.0 - style exaggeration costs latency and sounds theatrical; wrong for quotes and times.
settings_rationale.use_speaker_boost: true - clearer on a phone speaker at the workshop end.
settings_rationale.speed: 1.0. Do not speed up: prices, times and regos are the highest-risk tokens to mishear.

model_rationale: eleven_flash_v2_5 is the low-latency model (sub-second first audio when streamed). eleven_turbo_v2_5 is the fallback if flash is unavailable on the plan. eleven_multilingual_v2 is deliberately NOT used: several times the latency with no benefit for English.

shortlist.name: Charlie
shortlist.verdict: CHOSEN - local accent, conversational use-case, fastest render

shortlist.name: Alice
shortlist.verdict: Runner-up. Clearest articulation of the five, but a British accent reads as offshore call centre to Australian callers. Pick this if a female voice matters more than the local accent; then set Config.greeting_name_for_agent to Ava and speed to 1.02.

shortlist.name: Lily
shortlist.verdict: Too acted and velvety for a workshop

samples.note: All five rendered from the same 19-second script (greeting + minor-service quote + three slots) so they are directly comparable.

account.note: Sampling added ~1.9k characters. At roughly 700 characters per completed call the current plan is a few dozen calls - fine for testing, not for production. Move to a larger ElevenLabs plan, or set Vapi's voice provider to 'vapi' to use Vapi-bundled voices with no ElevenLabs quota.

vapi_mapping.note: Vapi streams from ElevenLabs and needs ELEVENLABS_API_KEY in Vapi's provider credentials. The key currently in Bitwarden is on the starter tier and is valid.
